paragraphs.source_en: Dragon-boat strokes the oars; At the heart of the tossing surf, an ugly monster strains and flares in combat. A pitch-black moon, round as a wheel, rolled into the green-visaged sun— that sun, green-faced and white-maned. Then the sun rushed back into the heart of the surge, transforming the sea creature into a wondrous idol. The sea became a vast desert. The statue of King Colbert stood in danger at the center of heaven and earth. With its mouth open, it swallowed the sun, and its whole body shone out a dreadful light. Myriads of yellow men, black men, and white men crawled across the heaving ground of waves. A champion like Vajrapāni, like a titan of granite, stepped up onto the mound of men. From the throng came uncanny mutterings, and one could not tell if they were grief or exultation. The warrior’s golden helm and plated cuirass flashed and glimmered, issuing sparks like fire. In an instant, huge fire coiled and rose; within the flames sat an august man. Like a Bodhisattva, like Goethe, like Plato, he sat enthroned, upon a lotus pedestal built from men’s skulls. A shocking flash of golden lightning— the jeweled tower of this man then took another form: in the stillness of the great desert, it became a triangular golden pyramid. Each block was a blazing dragon pearl. The tower was like a high-backed camel carrying a demon-man of neither short nor tall, who, with hideous eyes, cried out: “Have the slaves in this world ever perceived this news?”

units.source_zh:
一陣駭人的金電，──

這人寶塔又變形為

大漠裏清靜靜地

一座三角金字塔：

一個個金字，都是

放燄的龍珠，

塔像一隻高背的駱駝

馱著個不長不短的

人魔──他睜著怪眼大喊道：——

「奴隸的人間，可曾看出

此中的消息呀？」

地中海海樂悠揚；

浪濤的中心，

有醜怪奮鬥洶張；

一輪漆黑的明月，

滾入了青面的太陽──

青面白髮的太陽；

澆成奇偉的偶像；

大海化成了大漠；
